name: Research
description: Turn an open question into a sourced, reviewed research brief.

profiles.description: Project orchestrator. Clarifies scope, decomposes goals into dependency-aware tasks, delegates to specialists, integrates their work, and reports blockers and completion.
Research specialist. Finds current primary and authoritative sources, evaluates evidence, records citations and dates, and identifies uncertainty and gaps.
Research writer. Synthesizes verified evidence into clear, audience-appropriate briefs with citations, caveats, and actionable conclusions.
Independent research quality reviewer. Checks whether evidence supports claims, requirements are met, sources are reliable, and gaps or risks are clearly disclosed.

workflow_guidance: Clarify the question, decision context, audience, scope, and acceptance criteria before broad research.
Gather primary and authoritative sources; record links, dates, and exactly which claims each source supports.
Compare evidence and counterevidence; make uncertainty, conflicts, and evidence gaps explicit.
Synthesize findings into the requested deliverable with traceable citations and practical implications.
Use an independent reviewer to check factual support, completeness, clarity, and citation integrity before the planner closes the goal.
